description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing time with Maria.

Would you like help turning that into an email or message? I can draft/send/share one for you. Here are two quick templates you can use or modify — tell me which you want and who to send it to (or if you want it saved as a draft):

1) Short update to friends/family
Hi everyone — I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We explored nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a wonderfully relaxing break. Sharing a few photos soon! Hope you’re all well. — [Your name]

2) Thank-you note to Maria
Hi Maria — I had such a lovely weekend with you exploring the trails and getting out into the fresh air. Thanks for the company — let’s plan another getaway soon! Love, [Your name]

Tell me which template (or if you want a different tone), who the recipient is, and whether to send now or save as a draft — I’ll take care of it.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You spent the weekend in the countryside with your sister, Maria. You had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. 

Would you like me to draft a message or email about the trip (to friends, family, or Maria), or save one as a draft?
